simple.meaning: אִי־כָבוֹד (ʼÎy-kâbôwd) appears once in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with priesthood.

firstOccurrence.englishText: She named the child Ichabod,* “Ichabod” means “no glory”. saying, “The glory has departed from Israel!” because God’s ark was taken, and because of her father-in-law and her husband.

timeline.evidenceText: She named the child Ichabod,* “Ichabod” means “no glory”. saying, “The glory has departed from Israel!” because God’s ark was taken, and because of her father-in-law and her husband.
including Ahijah, the son of Ahitub, Ichabod’s brother, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eli, the priest of Yahweh in Shiloh, wearing an ephod. The people didn’t know that Jonathan was gone.
